old_contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #038: Fujita’s freeness conjecture.

Point-center verification on a smooth connected complex projective n-fold X with ample line bundle L, using the exact monomial tests and exponential objective of the staged September 23, 2026 manuscript.

definitions.f_m,t(x): infimum of exp(A(v)/t) times the basis average of exp(-v(s)/m), over nonzero admitted monomial tests with closed center containing x
definitions.reference-degree: for each m one test, frame, and Taylor order is fixed across all auxiliary degrees; centers and models may vary with m
definitions.restriction-image: I_W(h) is the dimension of the image of R_h in H^0(W,hL|_W), not the full space of sections on W

old_claim_versions.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 038 (Fujita’s freeness conjecture.; papers: Fujita's freeness conjecture; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.
For each 1<=d<=n there are C_d,H_d depending only on X,L,k,d such that (d! I_W(h))^(1/d)>=h-C_d for every integral d-dimensional W and every integer h>=H_d.

For any one admitted test with integral center of dimension d>0, restriction images yield pure tangential initials and a fixed-degree cube. All nonempty transverse slices satisfy uniform root-cardinality growth; summing with fixed exponential weights gives weighted B-growth and the simplex lower bound on tangential moment, in every sufficiently large auxiliary degree.

Assuming the manuscript specialization comparison in reference degree m, every minimizing monomial pair with d-dimensional center satisfies T_m<=d/t, by a right derivative at fixed m with tangent weights epsilon and fiber weights epsilon^2.

For arbitrary positive real d,t,a,sigma and every natural n, finite weighted slice-growth increments telescope into a partition lower bound; the exact exponential tangent and denominator-cleared algebra give the obstruction sigma*(t+a/(n+2))<=n+1 whenever the resulting limiting lower moment and upper moment d/t coexist. Formal declarations will state precisely which finite and scalar implications are kernel-checked; the geometric and limiting derivation is supplied separately.

Assume the exact uniform minimizer and specialization assertions exposed in report.md. Then any t in the common interval with n+1-a_*/(n+2)<t<n+1 has a liminf subsequence of arbitrarily large degrees on which every minimizing monomial pair has center exactly {x}. This holds in every dimension with varying integral centers and models and with differentiation at fixed m, then m tending to infinity at fixed partition length, then partition refinement.

old_claim_versions.natural_statement: For every natural n and positive real d,t,sigma with a>=0, if sigma*d*expRiemann(n,a/t,l)<=d/t for every integer l>=2, then sigma*(t+a/(n+2))<=n+1; expRiemann is exactly l^(-1) times the sum over 0<=i<l of (i/l)^n*exp((1-i/l)*a/t). The source also proves finite weighted power growth, telescoping into the moment estimate, an explicit O(1/l) lower approximation valid in every dimension, and existence of a suitable t when sigma=1 and a>0. For every smooth connected projective variety X over C of dimension n>=1 and every ample line bundle L, K_X+(n+1)L is globally generated. This is the manuscript target thm:main, not certified by the point-center mission.

If P=K_X+(n+1)L is not generated at x, there exist 0<t0<n+1, m0, c0>0, 0<delta<1, and 0<a_*<=a^* such that all m>=m0 and t in [t0,n+1] have attained minima c0<=f_m,t(x)<=1-delta and every minimizing test has discrepancy in [a_*,a^*]. For every fixed m with N_m>0 and integral W containing x, f_m,t(y)>=f_m,t(x) at a very general y in W for all t>0. These are unverified upstream manuscript assertions in this mission.
